item.description:

Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/INFO-01 Informatica

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Efficient numerical methods for Partial Differential Equations (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Rome
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-05 Analisi numerica

The research position focuses on numerical analysis and mathematical modeling, with particular emphasis on the development and analysis of efficient numerical methods for ordinary and partial differential equations. Research activities may include model order reduction techniques, optimal control methods for dynamical systems, and data-driven approaches for the identification and approximation of mathematical models, including machine learning techniques and Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs). item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-12 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/INFO-01 Informatica

The research project is part of WP3 of the European FORTIFY project, dedicated to the practical validation of workflows, governance models, technological tools and legal mechanisms for the secure sharing of health data protected by intellectual property (IP) within the EHDS. The research activity is aimed at managing a Secure Processing Environment (SPE), as an enabling technological infrastructure for the controlled and secure processing of sensitive health data, in compliance with the regulatory requirements and governance mechanisms established by the EHDS. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Interactions of Representation Theory and Topology (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-18 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-02 Algebra e geometria

Bazier-Matte and Schiffler developed a new categorification of the Alexander polynomial of a knot through quivers with potential and cluster algebras. The construction associates to a knot a quiver with potential and some of its representations. The aim of this project is to generalize the construction to the case of arbitrary planar graphs.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: 2026-IdrDip-02-mate - Normal functions, second fundamental form, correspond-ences, and lagrangian variety in algebraic geometry (Univ. PAVIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Univ. PAVIA, Pavia
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-02 Algebra e geometria

The goal is to study some problems in complex algebraic geometry using the methods of Hodge theory. Specifically, we will deepen results on the rank of normal functions, im-prove the bounds of the second fundamental form for sub-varieties of the moduli space of Abelian varieties, study correspondeces and construct new Lagrangian surfaces on Abelian varieties.
